criteria.label: Application posted
criteria.law: Hospitals must post their financial assistance application on their website so patients can apply.

criteria.label: Plain language summary posted
criteria.law: Hospitals must post a plain-language summary of their financial assistance policy.

criteria.label: Full policy posted
criteria.law: Hospitals must post their full financial assistance policy.

criteria.label: Documents consistent with each other
criteria.law: All of a hospital's financial assistance documents should give patients the same, correct information.

criteria.label: Service area defined correctly
criteria.law: A hospital's financial assistance must cover patients who live in at least the hospital's county and all neighboring counties (its 'primary service area').

criteria.label: No deadline to apply
criteria.law: There is no deadline to apply for hospital financial assistance. Patients can apply at any time.

criteria.label: No asset checks
criteria.law: Hospitals cannot consider a patient's assets (savings, property, bank accounts) when deciding financial assistance.

criteria.label: No immigration status barrier
criteria.law: Patients cannot be denied financial assistance because of their immigration status.

criteria.label: Uses the full NYS Uniform Application
criteria.law: Hospitals must use the full New York State Uniform Financial Assistance Application, not their own version.

criteria.label: Application lists who to contact
criteria.law: The application must tell patients who to contact for help with financial assistance.

criteria.label: Application shows income & discount tables
criteria.law: The application must show the income levels and the discount a patient gets at each level.

criteria.label: Application uses current FPL guidelines
criteria.law: Income limits must be based on the current year's Federal Poverty Level guidelines.

criteria.label: Application covers incomes up to 400% FPL
criteria.law: Patients with incomes up to 400% of the Federal Poverty Level qualify for financial assistance.

criteria.label: Application caps payment plans at 5% of income
criteria.law: Monthly payment plans cannot be more than 5% of a patient's gross monthly income.

criteria.label: Summary describes the service area
criteria.law: The plain-language summary must say which geographic area the hospital's financial assistance covers.

criteria.label: Summary explains how to apply
criteria.law: The plain-language summary must explain how to apply for financial assistance.

criteria.label: Summary lists income levels
criteria.law: The plain-language summary must list the income levels used to decide who qualifies.
